parsed.observations: Stems and leaf sheaths show elongated brick-red to red-brown pustules with torn epidermal margins, including dense clusters near the plant base. Leaves show yellow mottling and some lower-leaf yellowing; no clear yellow pustule stripes, white powdery growth, or black-dotted blotches are visible.
parsed.summary: Stem rust is indicated by elongated brick-red pustules with torn epidermal margins on stems and leaf sheaths.
